confidence: FIELD. A real worn WHOOP 5.0/MG per-second record (type 47, version 18) captured on hardware and committed with only biometrics + timestamp (no serial/name/token). Version 18 rides the second inner byte (inner[1]); the third byte is the on-wrist r22 command 0x80. Admitted fields reproduce byte-for-byte from the corpus-pinned offsets: HR 102 (body[11]), R-R 602/613 (count body[12], values body[13..]), gravity |g|=1.009 (three f32 from body[34]), skin temp 3057 u16 = 30.57 C (body[62:64], in the 5-45 C band), steps 50 (body[46]), activity 0 (body[52]), sleep state 0 (bits 5-4 of body[70]), signal quality 255 (body[29]). The capture is awake, so the sleep-only tri-mode SpO2 byte (body[71]) is 0 and stays unadmitted here, proving the 70..=100 gate on a real frame. The empirical signal_flags bitfield (body[22]=0) has no admitted stream kind and is not emitted. Still owes a check on our own strap in the hardware epoch.
